about_the_game:
The second in an epic five-part DLC series that adds legendary ships to the Caribbean waters, all connected by a tragic story.

In the azure waters of the Lesser Antilles, the elegant snow "Lady Beth" has appeared under the command of former British Navy officer Albert Blackwood. This brilliant captain, once the pride of the crown, left service to search for treasures and for the love of a beautiful lady. At least, that's what he tells himself. But behind the image of a lucky treasure hunter hides an unhappy soul, tormented by ghosts of the past and obsessed with dangerous ideas...

Purchase and you'll get:

  • A global map event, available in both story and sandbox modes

  • Albert Blackwood's visits to French ports of the Lesser Antilles, where you can gather rumors and meet the captain himself

  • Unique items – a legendary arquebus and a useful ward

  • An epic land battle against an experienced military man and his loyal crew

  • A fast and powerful snow with unique effects

  • Five new achievements

Gameplay tips:

  • You can upgrade the arquebus - hunt for treasures to get every part for it

  • The boss fight is designed for a character of at least level 10 with decent equipment, shooting skills, and officers
